requirements: R1: Investigate and resolve the underlying Flyway state synchronization root cause behind the failing PR #19 migration instead of masking it with 'IF NOT EXISTS'.

slices.title: Resolve PR #19 Flyway synchronization root cause
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Flyway synchronization fix for this epic, I want to investigate and remove the IF NOT EXISTS masking, so that the underlying migration failure mechanism is identified and resolved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Flyway database migration environment, When executing the migration that previously failed without IF NOT EXISTS, Then it should execute successfully and deterministically.
Given the PR #19 migration script, When reviewed, Then it must not contain the superficial IF NOT EXISTS check and must pass integration tests validating Flyway state.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of masked Flyway state errors from 1 to 0.
